verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit page explicitly lists GPU-accelerated libraries, compiler, runtime, Nsight profiling tools, and new CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python programming models as part of the developer toolchain, and RTX 50-series GPUs (Blackwell) are the current supported architecture for CUDA. This confirms the GPU is a supported CUDA target for shipping compute workloads. Missing for 10: an explicit statement naming 'RTX 5070 Ti' by SKU in CUDA compute-capability docs, and independent third-party confirmation of compute workload deployment on this specific card.
